topics.label: Introduction and Learning Outcomes
topics.groupedBecause: Introduces the lecture by connecting prior practical histology observations with the day's learning outcomes on cancer genetics and transformation.

topics.label: Viral Origins of Oncogenes and Transformation Assays
topics.groupedBecause: Explores how the study of tumor viruses revealed cellular proto-oncogenes and established laboratory assays used to test malignant transformation.

topics.label: Oncogenes, Tumor Suppressor Genes, and Cell Cycle Control
topics.groupedBecause: Examines how oncogenes and tumor suppressor mutations affect cell cycle checkpoints and produce distinct phenotypic effects depending on mutation type.

topics.label: Mechanisms and Consequences of Genetic Instability
topics.groupedBecause: Details the distinct molecular repair failures and mitotic defects that drive sequence and chromosomal instability in cancer cells.

topics.label: Multistep Tumor Progression and Hereditary Cancer Predisposition
topics.groupedBecause: Explains how the sequential accumulation of somatic or inherited mutations drives multistep tumorigenesis and clonal evolution.

topics.label: Conclusion and Recommended Reading
topics.groupedBecause: Closes the lecture by reviewing the covered material, providing reading recommendations, and outlining the next session.
